## Modificaciones en la simulación {.smaller}

- Quitar los elementos del mundo `empty.sdf`
- Añadir el modelo de la pista y las paredes


![](slides/figs/gazebo_view.png){width="100%" fig-align="center"}


## Alojar modelos de *Gazebo* {.smaller}

> Se añade una carpeta `models` al paquete para alojar los modelos de *Gazebo*


::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

- Se debe configurar adecuadamente el archivo `setup.py` para instalar los archivos correctamente

<br>


:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}

```default {code-line-numbers="false" code-line-numbers="4-6" filename="Workspace"}
📂 src
└── 📂 diffbot_gz
    ├── 📁 diffbot_gz
    ├── 📂 models
    │   ├── 📁 modelo_ejemplo
    │   └── ...
    ├── 📦 package.xml
    ├── 📁 resource
    ├── ⚙️ setup.cfg
    └── 🛠️ setup.py
```

:::
:::

<br>

```py {filename="setup.py" code-fold="true" code-line-numbers="false"}
setup(
  # ..
  data_files=[
    # ...
    # Install models inside the 'models/*' folder
    *[(os.path.join('share', package_name, os.path.split(p)[0]), [p])
         for p in glob(os.path.join('models', '**', '*.*'), recursive=True)]
  ],

```



## Añadir modelos a *Gazebo* {.smaller}

> Se agrega la carpeta `models` del paquete a la ruta (`PATH`) de *Gazebo*

<br>

```py {filename="gazebo.launch.py" code-line-numbers="false" code-line-numbers="|1|5-8|10-13"}
from launch.actions import AppendEnvironmentVariable

def generate_launch_description():
    # ..
    gz_resource_path = AppendEnvironmentVariable(
        'GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH',
        PathJoinSubstitution([FindPackageShare("<nombre_paquete>"), "models"]),
    )
    # ..
    return LaunchDescription([
        gz_resource_path,
        # ..
    ])

```


## Agregar y quitar entidades en *Gazebo* {.smaller}

> Para agregar entidades (similar al *spawn* de robots con *URDF*)

```py {filename="gazebo.launch.py" code-line-numbers="false" code-line-numbers="|3-5|7|8|13-16"}
def generate_launch_description():
    # ..
    load_model = Node(
        package="ros_gz_sim",
        executable="create",
        arguments=[
            "-entity", "<nombre_entidad>",
            "-file", "model://<nombre_modelo>",
        ],
        output="screen",
    )
    # ..
    return LaunchDescription([
        load_model,
        # ..
    ])

```

## Agregar y quitar entidades en *Gazebo* {.smaller}

> Para quitar entidades: `remove` del paquete `ros_gz_sim`

```py {filename="gazebo.launch.py" code-line-numbers="false" code-line-numbers="|3-5|6-8|12-15"}
def generate_launch_description():
    # ..
    remove_model = Node(
        package="ros_gz_sim",
        executable="remove",
        parameters=[
            { 'entity_name': '<nombre_entidad>'},
        ],
        output="screen",
    )
    # ..
    return LaunchDescription([
        remove_model,
        # ..
    ])

```
